facts.fact: The National Addressing Reference Project has 664 million dinars for its first phase across four pilot provinces including Ouargla, with workshops held in Ouargla, per APS as reported by DZWatch.
The Oran experimental phase produced over 311,000 unified, geolocatable official addresses, per APS as reported by DZWatch.
